title: cryptantha grayi var. cryptochaeta
intro: Cryptantha grayi var. cryptochaeta, commonly known as Gray's cryptantha, is a rare and endangered species of flowering plant in the borage family. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in the southwestern United States, where it has been employed to treat various health conditions. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and is used therapeutically for its ability to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of Gray's cryptantha include alkaloids and glycosides, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
